299  /**
300   * Validates the input parameters.
301   */
302  public void validate() throws PackagingException {
303    if (control == null || !control.isDirectory()) {
304      throw new PackagingException(
305        "The 'control' attribute doesn't point to a directory. " + control
306      );
307    }
308
309    if (changesEnabled) {
310      if (changesIn != null) {
311        if (
312          changesIn.exists() && (!changesIn.isFile() || !changesIn.canRead())
313        ) {
314          throw new PackagingException(
315            "The 'changesIn' setting needs to point to a readable file. " +
316              changesIn +
317              " was not found/readable."
318          );
319        }
320
321        if (changesOut != null && !isWritableFile(changesOut)) {
322          throw new PackagingException(
323            "Cannot write the output for 'changesOut' to " + changesOut
324          );
325        }
326
327        if (changesSave != null && !isWritableFile(changesSave)) {
328          throw new PackagingException(
329            "Cannot write the output for 'changesSave' to " + changesSave
330          );
331        }
332      } else {
333        if (changesOut != null || changesSave != null) {
334          throw new PackagingException(
335            "The 'changesOut' or 'changesSave' settings may only be used when there is a 'changesIn' specified."
336          );
337        }
338      }
339    }
340
341    if (Compression.toEnum(compression) == null) {
342      throw new PackagingException(
343        "The compression method '" +
344          compression +
345          "' is not supported (expected 'none', 'gzip', 'bzip2' or 'xz')"
346      );
347    }
348
349    if (deb == null) {
350      throw new PackagingException(
351        "You need to specify where the deb file is supposed to be created."
352      );
353    }
354
355    PGPSigner.getDigestCode(digest);
356  }
357
358  public void makeDeb() throws PackagingException {
359    BinaryPackageControlFile packageControlFile;
360    try {
361      console.info("Creating debian package: " + deb);
362
363      // If we should sign the package
364      if (signPackage) {
365        if (keyring == null || !keyring.exists()) {
366          console.warn("Signing requested, but no keyring supplied");
367        }
368
369        if (key == null) {
370          console.warn("Signing requested, but no key supplied");
371        }
372
373        if (passphrase == null) {
374          console.warn("Signing requested, but no passphrase supplied");
375        }
376
377        final int digestCode = PGPSigner.getDigestCode(signDigest);
378
379        PGPSigner signer;
380        try (FileInputStream keyRingInput = new FileInputStream(keyring)) {
381          signer = new PGPSigner(keyRingInput, key, passphrase, digestCode);
382        }
383
384        PGPSignatureGenerator signatureGenerator = new PGPSignatureGenerator(
385          new BcPGPContentSignerBuilder(
386            signer.getSecretKey().getPublicKey().getAlgorithm(),
387            digestCode
388          )
389        );
390        signatureGenerator.init(
391          PGPSignature.BINARY_DOCUMENT,
392          signer.getPrivateKey()
393        );
394
395        packageControlFile = createSignedDeb(
396          Compression.toEnum(compression),
397          signatureGenerator,
398          signer
399        );
400      } else {
401        packageControlFile = createDeb(Compression.toEnum(compression));
402      }
403    } catch (Exception e) {
404      throw new PackagingException("Failed to create debian package " + deb, e);
405    }
406
407    if (changesEnabled) {
408      makeChangesFiles(packageControlFile);
409    }
410  }
411
412  private void makeChangesFiles(
413    final BinaryPackageControlFile packageControlFile
414  ) throws PackagingException {
415    if (changesOut == null) {
416      changesOut = new File(
417        deb.getParentFile(),
418        FilenameUtils.getBaseName(deb.getName()) + ".changes"
419      );
420    }
421
422    ChangesProvider changesProvider;
423    FileOutputStream out = null;
424
425    try {
426      console.info("Creating changes file: " + changesOut);
427
428      changesOut.getParentFile().mkdirs();
429
430      out = new FileOutputStream(changesOut);
431
432      if (changesIn != null && changesIn.exists()) {
433        // read the changes form a textfile provider
434        changesProvider = new TextfileChangesProvider(
435          new FileInputStream(changesIn),
436          packageControlFile,
437          outputTimestampMs,
438          encoding
439        );
440      } else {
441        // create an empty changelog
442        changesProvider = () -> new ChangeSet[] {
443          new ChangeSet(
444            packageControlFile.get("Package"),
445            packageControlFile.get("Version"),
446            outputTimestampMs == null
447              ? new Date()
448              : new Date(outputTimestampMs),
449            packageControlFile.get("Distribution"),
450            packageControlFile.get("Urgency"),
451            packageControlFile.get("Maintainer"),
452            new String[0]
453          ),
454        };
455      }
456
457      ChangesFileBuilder builder = new ChangesFileBuilder(outputTimestampMs);
458      ChangesFile changesFile = builder.createChanges(
459        packageControlFile,
460        deb,
461        changesProvider
462      );
463
464      final int digestCode = PGPSigner.getDigestCode(signDigest);
465
466      // (signChanges || signPackage) - for backward compatibility. signPackage is signing both changes and deb.
467      if (
468        (signChanges || signPackage) &&
469        keyring != null &&
470        key != null &&
471        passphrase != null
472      ) {
473        console.info("Signing the changes file with the key " + key);
474        PGPSigner signer = new PGPSigner(
475          new FileInputStream(keyring),
476          key,
477          passphrase,
478          digestCode
479        );
480        signer.clearSign(changesFile.toString(), out);
481      } else {
482        out.write(changesFile.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
483      }
484      out.flush();
485    } catch (Exception e) {
486      throw new PackagingException(
487        "Failed to create the Debian changes file " + changesOut,
488        e
489      );
490    } finally {
491      IOUtils.closeQuietly(out);
492    }
493
494    if (
495      changesSave == null ||
496      !(changesProvider instanceof TextfileChangesProvider)
497    ) {
498      return;
499    }
500
501    try {
502      console.info("Saving changes to file: " + changesSave);
503
504      ((TextfileChangesProvider) changesProvider).save(
505        new FileOutputStream(changesSave)
506      );
507    } catch (Exception e) {
508      throw new PackagingException(
509        "Failed to save debian changes file " + changesSave,
510        e
511      );
512    }
513  }
514
515  private List<String> populateConffiles(Collection<DataProducer> producers) {
516    final List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
517
518    if (producers == null || producers.isEmpty()) {
519      return result;
520    }
521
522    final DataConsumer receiver = new DataConsumer() {
523      public void onEachFile(InputStream input, TarArchiveEntry entry) {
524        String tempConffileItem = entry.getName();
525
526        // Make sure the conffile path is absolute
527        if (tempConffileItem.startsWith(".")) {
528          tempConffileItem = tempConffileItem.substring(1);
529        }
530        if (!tempConffileItem.startsWith("/")) {
531          tempConffileItem = "/" + tempConffileItem;
532        }
533
534        console.info("Adding conffile: " + tempConffileItem);
535        result.add(tempConffileItem);
536      }
537
538      public void onEachLink(TarArchiveEntry entry) {}
539
540      public void onEachDir(TarArchiveEntry tarArchiveEntry) {}
541    };
542
543    try {
544      for (DataProducer data : producers) {
545        data.produce(receiver);
546      }
547    } catch (Exception e) {
548      //
549    }
550
551    return result;
552  }
553
554  /**
555   * Create the debian archive with from the provided control files and data producers.
556   *
557   * @param compression   the compression method used for the data file
558   * @return BinaryPackageControlFile
559   * @throws PackagingException
560   */
561  public BinaryPackageControlFile createDeb(Compression compression)
562    throws PackagingException {
563    return createSignedDeb(compression, null, null);
564  }
565
566  /**
567   * Create the debian archive with from the provided control files and data producers.
568   *
569   * @param compression   the compression method used for the data file (gzip, bzip2 or anything else for no compression)
570   * @param signatureGenerator   the signature generator
571   *
572   * @return PackageDescriptor
573   * @throws PackagingException
574   */
575  public BinaryPackageControlFile createSignedDeb(
576    Compression compression,
577    final PGPSignatureGenerator signatureGenerator,
578    PGPSigner signer
579  ) throws PackagingException {
580    File tempData = null;
581    File tempControl = null;
582
583    try {
584      tempData = File.createTempFile("deb", "data");
585      tempControl = File.createTempFile("deb", "control");
586
587      console.debug("Building data");
588      DataBuilder dataBuilder = new DataBuilder(console, outputTimestampMs);
589      StringBuilder md5s = new StringBuilder();
590      TarOptions options = new TarOptions()
591        .compression(compression)
592        .longFileMode(tarLongFileMode)
593        .bigNumberMode(tarBigNumberMode);
594      BigInteger size = dataBuilder.buildData(
595        dataProducers,
596        tempData,
597        md5s,
598        options,
599        ignoreBrokenLinks
600      );
601
602      console.info("Building conffiles");
603      List<String> tempConffiles = populateConffiles(conffilesProducers);
604
605      console.debug("Building control");
606      ControlBuilder controlBuilder = new ControlBuilder(
607        console,
608        variableResolver,
609        openReplaceToken,
610        closeReplaceToken,
611        outputTimestampMs
612      );
613      BinaryPackageControlFile packageControlFile =
614        controlBuilder.createPackageControlFile(
615          new File(control, "control"),
616          size,
617          encoding,
618          openReplaceToken,
619          closeReplaceToken
620        );
621      if (packageControlFile.get("Package") == null) {
622        packageControlFile.set("Package", packageName);
623      }
624      if (packageControlFile.get("Section") == null) {
625        packageControlFile.set("Section", section);
626      }
627      if (packageControlFile.get("Description") == null) {
628        packageControlFile.set("Description", description);
629      }
630      if (packageControlFile.get("Depends") == null) {
631        // Only add a depends entry to the control file if the field in this object has actually been set
632        if (depends != null && depends.length() > 0) {
633          packageControlFile.set("Depends", depends);
634        }
635      }
636      if (packageControlFile.get("Homepage") == null) {
637        packageControlFile.set("Homepage", homepage);
638      }
639
640      controlBuilder.buildControl(
641        packageControlFile,
642        control.listFiles(),
643        tempConffiles,
644        md5s,
645        tempControl,
646        encoding
647      );
648
649      if (!packageControlFile.isValid()) {
650        throw new PackagingException(
651          "Control file fields are invalid " +
652            packageControlFile.invalidFields() +
653            ". The following fields are mandatory: " +
654            packageControlFile.getMandatoryFields() +
655            ". Please check your pom.xml/build.xml and your control file."
656        );
657      }
658
659      deb.getParentFile().mkdirs();
660
661      ArArchiveOutputStream ar = new ArArchiveOutputStream(
662        new FileOutputStream(deb)
663      );
664
665      String binaryName = "debian-binary";
666      String binaryContent = "2.0\n";
667      String controlName = "control.tar.gz";
668      String dataName = "data.tar" + compression.getExtension();
669
670      addTo(ar, binaryName, binaryContent);
671      addTo(ar, controlName, tempControl);
672      addTo(ar, dataName, tempData);
673
674      if (signatureGenerator != null) {
675        console.info("Signing package with key " + key);
676
677        if (signRole == null) {
678          signRole = "origin";
679        }
680
681        // Use debsig-verify as default
682        if (!"dpkg-sig".equals(signMethod)) {
683          // Sign file to verify with debsig-verify
684          PGPSignatureOutputStream sigStream = new PGPSignatureOutputStream(
685            signatureGenerator
686          );
687
688          addTo(sigStream, binaryContent);
689          addTo(sigStream, tempControl);
690          addTo(sigStream, tempData);
691          addTo(ar, "_gpg" + signRole, sigStream.generateASCIISignature());
692        } else {
693          // Sign file to verify with dpkg-sig --verify
694          final String outputStr =
695            "Version: 4\n" +
696            "Signer: \n" +
697            "Date: " +
698            new SimpleDateFormat(
699              "EEE MMM dd HH:mm:ss yyyy",
700              Locale.ENGLISH
701            ).format(new Date()) +
702            "\n" +
703            "Role: " +
704            signRole +
705            "\n" +
706            "Files: \n" +
707            addFile(binaryName, binaryContent) +
708            addFile(controlName, tempControl) +
709            addFile(dataName, tempData);
710
711          ByteArrayOutputStream message = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
712          signer.clearSign(outputStr, message);
713
714          addTo(ar, "_gpg" + signRole, message.toString());
715        }
716      }
717
718      ar.close();
719
720      return packageControlFile;
721    } catch (Exception e) {
722      throw new PackagingException("Could not create deb package", e);
723    } finally {
724      if (tempData != null) {
725        if (!tempData.delete()) {
726          console.warn("Could not delete the temporary file " + tempData);
727        }
728      }
729      if (tempControl != null) {
730        if (!tempControl.delete()) {
731          console.warn("Could not delete the temporary file " + tempControl);
732        }
733      }
734    }
735  }
736
737  private String addFile(String name, String input) {
738    return addLine(md5Hash(input), sha1Hash(input), input.length(), name);
739  }
740
741  private String addFile(String name, File input) {
742    return addLine(md5Hash(input), sha1Hash(input), input.length(), name);
743  }
744
745  private String addLine(String md5, String sha1, long size, String name) {
746    return "\t" + md5 + " " + sha1 + " " + size + " " + name + "\n";
747  }
748
749  private String md5Hash(String input) {
750    return md5Hash(input.getBytes());
751  }
752
753  private String md5Hash(File input) {
754    try {
755      return md5Hash(FileUtils.readFileToByteArray(input));
756    } catch (IOException e) {
757      // TODO Auto-generated catch block
758      e.printStackTrace();
759    }
760
761    return null;
762  }
763
764  private String md5Hash(byte[] input) {
765    //update the input of MD5
766    MD5Digest md5 = new MD5Digest();
767    md5.update(input, 0, input.length);
768
769    //get the output/ digest size and hash it
770    byte[] digest = new byte[md5.getDigestSize()];
771    md5.doFinal(digest, 0);
772
773    return new String(Hex.encode(digest));
774  }
775
776  private String sha1Hash(String input) {
777    return sha1Hash(input.getBytes());
778  }
779
780  private String sha1Hash(File input) {
781    try {
782      return sha1Hash(FileUtils.readFileToByteArray(input));
783    } catch (IOException e) {
784      // TODO Auto-generated catch block
785      e.printStackTrace();
786    }
787
788    return null;
789  }
790
791  private String sha1Hash(byte[] input) {
792    try {
793      //prepare the input
794      MessageDigest hash = MessageDigest.getInstance(digest);
795      hash.update(input);
796
797      //proceed ....
798      byte[] digest = hash.digest();
799
800      return new String(Hex.encode(digest));
801    } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
802      System.err.println("No such algorithm");
803      e.printStackTrace();
804    }
805
806    return null;
807  }

809  private void addTo(
810    ArArchiveOutputStream pOutput,
811    String pName,
812    String pContent
813  ) throws IOException {
814    final byte[] content = pContent.getBytes();
815    ArArchiveEntry archiveEntry = createArArchiveEntry(pName, content.length);
816
817    pOutput.putArchiveEntry(archiveEntry);
818    pOutput.write(content);
819    pOutput.closeArchiveEntry();
820  }
821
822  private void addTo(ArArchiveOutputStream pOutput, String pName, File pContent)
823    throws IOException {
824    ArArchiveEntry archiveEntry = createArArchiveEntry(
825      pName,
826      pContent.length()
827    );
828
829    pOutput.putArchiveEntry(archiveEntry);
830    try (InputStream input = new FileInputStream(pContent)) {
831      Utils.copy(input, pOutput);
832    }
833
834    pOutput.closeArchiveEntry();
835  }
836
837  private void addTo(
838    final PGPSignatureOutputStream pOutput,
839    final String pContent
840  ) throws IOException {
841    final byte[] content = pContent.getBytes();
842    pOutput.write(content);
843  }
844
845  private void addTo(
846    final PGPSignatureOutputStream pOutput,
847    final File pContent
848  ) throws IOException {
849    try (InputStream input = new FileInputStream(pContent)) {
850      Utils.copy(input, pOutput);
851    }
852  }

855    this.openReplaceToken = openReplaceToken;
856  }

858  public void setCloseReplaceToken(String closeReplaceToken) {
859    this.closeReplaceToken = closeReplaceToken;
860  }
861
862  private ArArchiveEntry createArArchiveEntry(
863    String pName,
864    long contentLength
865  ) {
866    if (outputTimestampMs != null) {
867      return new ArArchiveEntry(
868        pName,
869        contentLength,
870        0,
871        0,
872        DEFAULT_MODE,
873        outputTimestampMs / TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(1)
874      );
875    }
876
877    return new ArArchiveEntry(pName, contentLength);
878  }
